boundary: IEC supplies the performance gas heater inlet flange; EPC supplies the counter-flange, gasket (spiral wound, 316L/graphite), stud bolts and the pipe support nearest the flange, and makes the joint. Hydrotest up to the flange by each party; joint leak test with gas-in by EPC.
connection: ASME B16.5 CL600 RF weld-neck flange
contractor_side: IEC: performance gas heater inlet flange
isolation: EPC: gas station outlet ESD valve (fail-closed, SIL 2, closed by the TCS gas trip) and manual valve with spectacle blind upstream of IF-01. IEC: gas skid stop and control valves.
metering: Fiscal metering (ultrasonic 2 x 100 % + gas chromatograph) in the EPC gas station; IEC skid flow meter for control only.
operating_conditions: Pressure rate of change <= 0.7 bar/s; >= 28 K superheat above hydrocarbon and water dew points; filtration 3 um absolute; below 36.5 barg the TCS load limiter applies (DEC-EPCE-0003).
owner_side: EPC: gas from EPC gas receiving/metering station
protection: EPC gas station pressure control: monitor + active regulator, slam-shut set 46 barg, token relief 44 barg; downstream design 63 barg (EN 12186 / ASME B31.8).
